input.command:
cd /Users/vitaliy/Documents/GitHub/local-whisper
hs -c 'local f,e=loadfile(os.getenv("HOME").."/Documents/GitHub/local-whisper/hammerspoon/init.lua"); return f and "SYNTAX OK" or ("ERR: "..tostring(e))'
hs -c "hs.reload()" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 4
rm -rf /tmp/lwtest2 && mkdir -p /tmp/lwtest2
hs -c 'LWCAP=nil
LWTEST2 = hs.task.new(os.getenv("HOME").."/.local-whisper/bin/lw-record",
  function(c,o,e) local f=io.open("/tmp/lwtest2/result.txt","w"); f:write("exit="..tostring(c).."\ncaptured="..tostring(LWCAP)); f:close() end,
  function(t,so,se) if so then local c=tonumber(so:match("CAPTURED%s+([%d%.]+)")); if c then LWCAP=c end end return true end,
  {"/tmp/lwtest2","1","16000"})
LWTEST2:start(); return "started"'
sleep 8; hs -c 'LWTEST2:interrupt(); return "ok"'; sleep 2
echo "=== streaming-callback capture of CAPTURED ==="; cat /tmp/lwtest2/result.txt
input.description: Verify CAPTURED parses via streaming callback
